title: AI-Augmented Surveys: Leveraging Large Language Models and Surveys for Opinion Prediction

bias_targets.methodology: Estimating OLS regression models to compare the Area Under the Curve (AUC) for predicting individual survey responses across different income and education levels, identifying higher predictability for individuals with higher socioeconomic status.

Estimating OLS regression models to compare the AUC for predicting individual survey responses across different racial groups, identifying lower predictive accuracy for racial minorities compared to White respondents.

Estimating OLS regression models to compare the AUC for predicting individual survey responses across different political affiliations, finding that strong partisans are predicted more accurately than independents.
Estimating OLS regression models to compare the AUC for predicting individual survey responses across various age brackets.
Estimating OLS regression models to compare the AUC for predicting individual survey responses between female and male respondents.
Estimating OLS regression models to compare the AUC for predicting individual survey responses across different geographic regions.
